value: Khay’ji next describes the Zaxxis as ethereals who left the Consortium and made dealings with the Sunfury. He says he infiltrated their camp, took out its leader, then escaped to Area 52. Insignias from the Heap are a lead, not a new political settlement. The turn-in brings another report: Warp-Raider Nesaad still lives. Khay’ji admits the failure and sends the seeker back. The chain begins with divided loyalties and an agent who did not finish his own task.
editorNote: Khay’ji’s infiltration and the reported Zaxxis dealings are attributed to his quest dialogue. Repeated collection and combat objectives are compressed, not narrated as separate events. Research status: accessible sources reproduce quest material but are not original-client captures. Do not promote before source and edition review.
